card.name: Linking words after a website mention
card.fires_on: Small linking words (or, by, your, in) right after a web address or a mention of the Web, where the text goes on to offer another way to get information or contact someone.

modes.label: Or/by after a web address
modes.description: The word 'or' or 'by' follows a website address and introduces a phone or email alternative.
modes.example: Information about ZENBEXUS REMS is available at www.ZENBEXUSREMS.com or<< by>> calling the REMS Call Center at

modes.label: Web-use wording
modes.description: A word such as 'your' or 'or' inside a sentence about sharing or posting on the Web or other electronic media.
modes.example: DO NOT steal, scavenge, or repost this work on the Web<< or>> any electronic media.

card.writes: Suppresses words like virtual, online and software, so the next word is less likely to be one of these computer terms.
card.plain: It marks the little word after a website mention, just before the text offers another route such as a phone call or an email.
